SQL:
SELECT
  CAST(EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM orders.order_date) AS INT) AS "orders.iso_dow",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum",
  COUNT(*) AS "orders._count"
FROM orders AS orders
WHERE
  orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND orders.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  CAST(EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM orders.order_date) AS INT)
ORDER BY
  "orders.iso_dow" ASC
LIMIT 21
